note: Weapon mass and rifling-twist captures for the open worklist. Mass rows are keyed by the catalogue weapon_key; twist rows by the catalogue weapon_id. Values are maker-published technical data only. Sako and Tikka pages embed the maker product JSON (rifleProductTotalWeight in kg, rifleRateOfTwist in inches); Bergara values come from the 2026 catalogue specification tables; B&T from the product technical-information tables; Zastava from the maker technical-data tables.
